dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, tell me a funny anecdote! What was the most awkward moment of your life?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈtɛl miː ə ˈfʌni ˈænɪkdoʊt! ˈwʌt wʌz ðə ˈmoʊst ˈɔːkwərd ˈmoʊmənt əv jʊr ˈlaɪf?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's easy. It happened in my first week at university.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ðæts ˈiːzi. ɪt ˈhæpənd ɪn maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈwiːk ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I was sitting in a big lecture hall. I had stayed up late the night before, so I was really sleepy.
dialogue.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪn ə ˈbɪɡ ˈlɛktʃər ˌhɔːl. aɪ hæd ˈsteɪd ˈʌp ˈleɪt ðə ˈnaɪt bɪˈfɔːr, soʊ aɪ wʌz ˈriːli ˈsliːpi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The professor was asking questions, and suddenly she said my name.
dialogue.reading: ðə prəˈfɛsər wʌz ˈæskɪŋ ˈkwɛstʃənz, ənd ˈsʌdənli ʃiː ˈsɛd maɪ ˈneɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I said, "Yes, Mom!" Everyone in the room started laughing.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsɛd, ˈjɛs, ˈmɑːm! ˈɛvriwʌn ɪn ðə ˈruːm ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈlæfɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's hilarious! What did the professor do?
dialogue.reading: ðæts hɪˈlɛriəs! ˈwʌt dɪd ðə prəˈfɛsər ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She smiled and said, "I'm not your mom, but please answer the question."
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈsmaɪld ənd ˈsɛd, aɪm ˈnɑːt jʊr ˈmɑːm, bʌt ˈpliːz ˈænsər ðə ˈkwɛstʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It was only a small incident, but I'll never forget it.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈoʊnli ə ˈsmɔːl ˈɪnsɪdənt, bʌt aɪl ˈnɛvər fərˈɡɛt ɪt.
